plan.english: Lord of the clan, hear me! Who are you, stranger, and who sent you? The king of the other people sent me. They dwell beyond the river. What does he want from us? He wants peace between the peoples. He gives you ten horses as pledges. A king's word is better than horses. Will he swear an oath by the gods? He will swear it, and the gods will see it. Then come back at the new moon with your king.

title: When the river people were foes

plan.english: Elder, were the people of the river our foes? They were our foes. I remember the slaughter at the ford. Their men drove off our cattle, and our men killed many. Why is there peace now? Our chief gave his own daughter to their chief. Now her children are our kin, and they guard our herds. Will the peace stand? It will stand if men keep their oaths. Do you know them?

title: A bride-price of horses and silver

title: How your people greet a guest

Your words are like our words. Our two tongues are sisters. My grandmother came from your people. Did you not know it?

title: The dogs that killed the sheep

plan.english: Your dogs killed three of my sheep in the night. Did you see it with your own eyes? I saw them. Their mouths were red with blood. Then I owe you a price. What is a sheep worth? A sheep is worth a measure of grain. Pay me three measures, and bind your dogs. I will pay, and I will bind them. But do not strike my dogs. If they come again, I will kill them.

title: The king's daughter answers the envoy

plan.english: Daughter of the king, Of-Good-Fame asks for you as his wife. Why did he not come to me? He is guarding his herds from the wolves. Is he old? Is he kindly? He is strong, and his fame is great. Fame does not warm a woman in the night. I will choose my husband for myself. What shall I tell him? Tell him: let him come to the feast, and I will see him with my own eyes.

title: The hostage boy who misses home
